name: Adapta Studio
description: Nowadays, highly-defined 3D objects play a central role in computer graphics. ADAPTA studio aims at supporting graphic designers and companies in creating 3D models stuck to reality, while reducing computational resources. Our AMAZ3D products provide an automatic optimization of 3D graphical models, by reducing the memory allocation while preserving the quality of the original objects. Polygon optimization and reduction, remeshing, texture projection and LOD are the tools available for you.
sector: New ways of working and living

name: Agade
description: AGADE is a startup and spin-off of Politecnico di Milano, which aims at bringing to the market AGADEXO, a new generation of exoskeleton designed to reduce work related muscular diseases due to fast and long lasting fatiguing tasks such as pick&place, typical of the logistic and manufacturing fields. AGADEXO is based on a patent pending technology of actuation designed to realize smart but light, compact and low cost exoskeletons, capable of applying an adaptive and comfortable human augmentation.

name: AIBlooms
description: Aiblooms is a spin-off of Politecnico di Milano dedicated to the development of AI and machine learning-based software.
sector: New ways of working and living

name: Artiness
description: Artiness is a new company offering innovative solutions to exploit augmented reality in the clinical world. We have a challenging vision: to move beyond the limits of current clinical methodologies using the revolutionary power of augmented reality with 4D holograms. From widely used clinical imaging techniques we can obtain scalable, patient-specific and realistic reconstructions of the human body.

name: Billding
description: Billding is a digital platform designed to help individuals and SMEs get an accurate estimate of savings on electricity, gas, internet and telephony in real time, leveraging the latest AI and OCR technologies
sector: New ways of working and living

name: Blimp
description: Blimp is a Data Company that uses artificial intelligence to analyze the flows of people and vehicles in urban environments, supporting companies in their strategic decisions.
sector: New ways of working and living

name: Bonus X
description: BonusX is a digital platform that helps citizens and corporate employees discover and apply for more than 600 bonuses and public benefits, simplifying the tax bureaucracy.
sector: New ways of working and living

name: Cambridge Raman Imaging
description: Cambridge Raman Imaging brings together ultra-fast fibre based lasers and Coherent Raman spectroscopy to make high-speed truly chemometric label-free imaging possible. Our first application is in medical imaging and our focus is on bringing to market Raman imaging instruments capable of scanning tissues in seconds to differentiate between diseased and healthy sections, delivering better patient outcomes through faster and more accurate tumour diagnosis and treatment.

name: Ecosmic
description: Ecosmic wants to empower sustainable space operations, by transitioning to a fully software-based operations model, to be embedded on the satellite. Our first go-to market product is SAFE, a tool to avoid collisions in space.

name: EFESO
description: EFESO addresses the unsustainability of ICT energy consumption, which is expected to reach 20 percent of global production by 2030. The project will exploit a new class of quantum materials we have discovered to develop ultra-low-power electronic components, far beyond current CMOS technology.

name: Empatica
description: Empatica is a small team of passionate people who develops groundbreaking wearable devices with clinical quality sensing. The team has diverse engineering and business competences. Empatica designs and develops the world’s smallest and most accurate wearable device for medical research of human behavior in daily life. The product “E4” is used in 30 countries around the world, its clients are the most respected hospitals, universities, and companies that use it for advanced research on human behavior. The E4 provides the most sophisticated way to monitor autonomic nervous system disruption and heart rate variability, among a set of 5 sensors. Embrace watch is the latest product and it is the first medical-quality wearable to help measure stress, epileptic seizures, activity and sleep. The Embrace watch is linked to the wearer’s mobile device with a Bluetooth connection. This connection allows Empatica systems to analyze the information and detect unusual events like convulsive seizures in real-time and alert family members and caregivers who can then intervene.

name: Energy Dome
description: Develops long-term carbon dioxide-based energy storage solutions, offering an efficient and sustainable alternative to traditional batteries.

name: Eye4Nir
description: The product consists of an image sensor formed by an array of pixels, which is the basic component of a camera. The sensor of EYE4NIR is a simple, compact, and low-cost hyperspectral sensor.

name: FAST Aerospace
description: FAST Aerospace's ultimate goal is to develop HyperDart, a sustainable and reusable launch vehicle for small satellites that can take off from conventional runways. HyperDart will provide unprecedented flexibility and responsiveness, democratizing access to space.

name: Fili Pari
description: Fili Pari is an italian Brand focused on the development of innovative materials in textile industry, respecting the territory and the environment. Partnership with specialized companies have allowed the creation of a synergy between the Italian stone district and the textile sector, activating a new production chain. Through an analysis of the problems, combined with research and innovation, we developed cutting-edge technologies for the enhancement of marble powders. The resulting product is Veromarmo, a patented wearable microfilm containing marble powder, which promotes an efficient use of marble powder. The membrane is suitable for interior and fashion, and it could be extended in shoes sector, nautical and other different specific area. The passion for the territory and nature is reflected into the desire to value the material through sustainable development, selecting raw materials in accordance with the environment. Thanks to constant research and the increasingly advanced technology, even waste marbles become raw materials. Fili Pari promotes Veromarmo both through third party selling of the material and also with their rainwear private label.

name: HelioƧwitch
description: HelioƧwitch offers an innovative cloud-based service to support optimal dispatching of demand and generation flexibility via energy markets probabilistic modeling and weather forecast uncertainty propagation. The balancing in power systems is particularly difficult due to the high number of uncertainties (e.g. uncertainties in electricity consumption, weather forecast uncertainties, etc.). Taking the impact of these uncertainties into account requires an approach capable of handling them. That’s the target of HelioƧwitch.

name: Indigo AI
description: Indigo.ai offers a "no-code" platform that enables companies to design advanced virtual assistants (chatbots, voicebots) using deep learning models and conversational artificial intelligence.
sector: New ways of working and living

name: Isaac
description: ISAAC is an Italian startup based in Milan. Active since 2018, it is proposed as a player in the construction sector for the supply of smart technologies for seismic protection and structures monitoring. Specialized in the development of smart solutions for seismic protection and structural monitoring, ISAAC has I-Pro 1 patented: the first self-adaptive, plug-and play and one-fit-all-for-seismic protection technology, applicable to existing buildings. Recognized by Wired among the 10 Italian startups to keep an eye on in 2020, ISAAC boasts important partnerships with technological research and innovation players. ISAAC aims to revolutionize the anti-seismic practice by promoting the prevention culture and made accessible the possibility of protecting the built environment to everyone and in any context thanks to non-invasive and simple to install technologies

name: Leafspace
description: Leaf Space aims to become a global leading service provider in the new, emerging microsatellite market by developing a technology platform providing all basic services required by microsatellite operators.

name: Lithium Lasers
description: Today, ultrafast lasers are indispensable tools for many innovative scientific and industrial applications. Neuroscience, medicine and mass production high-tech industrial processes rely on the power of ultrafast to push their capabilities and widen their horizons. Lithium lasers with its patent pending solutions and its dedicated production platforms brings this expensive and fragile technology to a more mature level of industrialization.

name: Magic Vision
description: Magic Vision brings artificial intelligence to the field of elderly care, developing an integrated system to monitor access and movement.
sector: New ways of working and living

name: Narvalo
description: Narvalo is a startup and Spin-Off Politecnico di Milano that designs and produces devices and services to improve something that surrounds us all but think little about, the air we breathe. Our first product lineup consists of the Narvalo Urban Mask and the smart add-on ‘Active Shield’ (Italian patent pending technology), are masks designed to protect you from air pollution in urban areas combining comfort, protection, performance, and sustainability

name: NAUTILUS
description: Nautilus is the first private European company able to provide complete mission analysis and flight dynamics (orbit determination and orbit control) services for deep space missions carried out with CubeSats and SmallSats.

name: Nireos
description: NIREOS is a spin-off company of the Physics Department of Politecnico di Milano, with headquarters located in Milan (Italy). The core business of NIREOS is represented by the development of groundbreaking technologies in photonics and spectroscopy. NIREOS’ portfolio includes novel and patented devices, such as broadband spectrometers and hyperspectral cameras. NIREOS’ main customers are represented by scientific research labs as well as R&D departments of industries, which exploit the power of spectroscopic analysis to perform accurate and non-destructive quality control processes.

name: OpenMall
description: The largest social commerce platform entirely powered by artificial intelligence, which—through an interactive 3D platform, virtual assistants, and mixed reality—offers users and stores a unique, personalized experience.
sector: New ways of working and living

name: Overspace Aviation
description: Overspace Aviation offers an innovative and sustainable solution with its VTOL Dragonfly DS-1, which provides a customized, safe and cost-effective response through its unique, modular and patented design.

name: Postura Ergonomics
description: Postura Ergonomics is a SaaS that revolutionizes ergonomic assessments, offering fast, objective and cost-effective solutions through artificial intelligence.
sector: New ways of working and living

name: Remedy Technologies
description: Remedy Technologies S.r.l. is an innovative Med Tech startup focused on the research and development of new materials and technological solutions for the treatment of oncological pathologies affecting the spine. Through the design, development, certification, and market introduction of spinal stabilization systems, Remedy Technologies makes the surgeon's work simpler and more effective and contributes to improving patient well-being.

name: SMUSH Materials
description: SMUSH Materials is an innovative startup that develops sustainable biomaterials for secondary packaging solutions dedicated to heavy or fragile products. Using natural mycelium technology and exploiting advanced fermentation processes, SMUSH transforms agricultural by-products into high mechanical performance, compostable and circular packaging solutions. The goal is to replace traditional high-impact single-use plastics with high-performance natural alternatives, significantly reducing environmental impact and promoting the transition to a more sustainable economy.

name: Supair
description: Innovative electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft using patented ThrustPod technology that offers 50 percent greater efficiency than any other urban aerial vehicle (UAM).

name: Synergy Flow
description: SINERGY FLOW develops a sustainable, low-cost, and highly efficient redox flow battery for the energy storage on a multi-day basis, allowing the penetration of renewables in the energy ecosystem up to 90 %.
